thread:
elaine_sales: Quick heads-up — ACME just signed the LOI. They want a BYOK POC with HSM attestation, cross-region key replication, and monthly rotation. They also pushed the security questionnaire to be answered by EOD Wed. Who can own tech + sec + pricing asks?

omar_se: I can lead the POC runbook. Need to confirm: are they expecting cloud HSM (CloudHSM/CloudKMS) or physical HSM appliances talking KMIP? Also: do they require remote attestation + firmware hash verification or just an attestation report?

maria_sec: I’ll take the sec questionnaire. We need their legal redlines on key custody. Our standard: keys never persist unencrypted on Redwood hosts; customer key material only in HSM or via wrapped key flow. Monthly rotation is aggressive — we usually recommend quarterly unless they accept the support surcharge.

tim_ops: FYI Dedicated + BYOK + HSM connectors add ops work. Quick notes:
- Network: firewall allowlist to HSM endpoints, mTLS to our connector.
- Audit: we will surface rotation events in Console and ship audit logs to their SIEM (S3/Cloudwatch) for retention.
- Cost: estimate +20% on reserved capacity for HSM connector SLA + $X/day ops monitoring for per-rotation support.

aaron_engineering: On the integration side: handshake we support today is PKCS#11 + KMIP over TLS. For remote attestation we can validate a signing cert chain and firmware hash if the vendor exposes it. For seamless rotation we do dual-write during rollout: new key injected, replicas warmed, then primary flips. Example rotation policy snippet:```
rotation_policy:
  window: 2h
  dual_key_write: true
  fallback_model: quant-2bit-small
```

elaine_sales: Customer asked whether key material ever leaves their HSM. We need a crisp line: 'keys never stored in plaintext on Redwood infrastructure' — can we confirm and add to secq answer? Also they want pricing delta for monthly vs quarterly rotation.

maria_sec: Confirmed line is okay: we only store wrapped keys (with customer KEK) and unwrapped key material never persisted on Redwood. We'll include attestation requirements in the response: vendor-signed attestation + last 3 firmware hashes + chain of custody.

omar_se: For the POC runbook I'll need: contact at their infra team, HSM vendor + endpoint docs, firewall IPs, and a sample key rotation schedule. I'll draft a 2-week POC plan with canary traffic, failback steps, and smoke tests.

jen_bizops: I'll prep the SOW addendum: options: (A) quarterly rotation standard, (B) monthly rotation — +15% ops surcharge, (C) continuous monthly with 24/7 managed support — custom pricing. Also adding a one-time onboarding fee for HSM connector setup.

tim_ops: One more ops note: if they require cross-region synchronous replication of key states, that increases cost/latency. Recommend asynchronous replication with automated conflict resolution unless they demand sync. 

elaine_sales: Action items: omar — runbook draft by Mon EOD; maria — secq first pass by Tue noon; jen — SOW outline & pricing by Tue EOD; tim/aaron — short doc on network & attestation requirements by Tue EOD. I’ll own customer comms and negotiating monthly vs quarterly. Ping me when you post drafts. :thumbsup:

omar_se: Got it, tagging @aaron_engineering for any infra clarifications. Will upload runbook draft to the deal folder when ready.

maria_sec: I'll upload secq answers and the attestation checklist to the same folder. If they insist on monthly rotation, we need signed SLA exception and change request.

jen_bizops: Noted — adding a line item for SLA exception and estimated hours.

elaine_sales: Great — thanks all. If anyone hits blockers (legal redlines or vendor attestation not available) we escalate to me + legal.

aaron_engineering: Quick FYI for the POC: provide a sample key in PEM + a test enclave for attestation, and we can run a full end-to-end smoke (encrypt -> inference -> rotate -> decrypt) in ~48h once access is live.

elaine_sales: Perfect. I'll coordinate access and send invite for a kickoff call tomorrow.
